entities.summary: St. Benedictusberg Abbey, also Mamelis Abbey, is a Benedictine monastery established in 1922 in Mamelis, a hamlet which administratively falls within Vaals, Netherlands. It is a rijksmonument. Benedictusberg Abbey is a abbey in Europe, established in 1987. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
